research_question: Can Q remain the sole optimization and checkpoint target while an adaptive inequality constraint on P reduces parameter compensation and improves validation x0.95 risk?
optimization_problem: minimize L_Q(theta) subject to L_P(theta) <= tau
constraint_solver: inequality augmented Lagrangian with projected non-negative multiplier

constraint_grid.p_reference: matched P baseline best validation L_P in pq_regularized_pilot

selection.candidate_feasibility: validation L_P <= tau in at least 7 of 8 units
selection.candidate_choice: lowest pooled validation L_Q among feasible candidates
selection.promising_gate: at least 0.5% validation rRMSE improvement over pure Q and at least 6 of 8 units improved

test_policy: No test evaluation or saved test prediction in this pilot.
